rows.hebrew: שְׂא֗וּ אֶת רֹאשׁ֙ כָּל עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֔וֹת כָּל זָכָ֖ר לְ/גֻלְגְּלֹתָֽ/ם
rows.fluent: “Take a census of the whole Israelite community by clan and ancestral household. List every male by name, one by one,

rows.hebrew: מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כָּל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תִּפְקְד֥וּ אֹתָ֛/ם לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֖/ם אַתָּ֥ה וְ/אַהֲרֹֽן
rows.fluent: from twenty years old and upward—all in Israel who can serve in the army. You and Aaron are to register them by their military divisions.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל הַ/פְּקֻדִ֔ים שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וּ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּֽׁים
rows.fluent: The total number registered was 603,550.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֑/ם לֹ֥א הָתְפָּקְד֖וּ בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
rows.fluent: The Levites, however, were not registered with them by their ancestral tribe.

rows.hebrew: אַ֣ךְ אֶת מַטֵּ֤ה לֵוִי֙ לֹ֣א תִפְקֹ֔ד וְ/אֶת רֹאשָׁ֖/ם לֹ֣א תִשָּׂ֑א בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
rows.fluent: “Do not register the tribe of Levi or include them in the census of the Israelites.

rows.hebrew: וּ/בִ/נְסֹ֣עַ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֗ן יוֹרִ֤ידוּ אֹת/וֹ֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם וּ/בַ/חֲנֹת֙ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יָקִ֥ימוּ אֹת֖/וֹ הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וְ/הַ/זָּ֥ר הַ/קָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת
rows.fluent: When the tabernacle moves, the Levites are to take it down. When it comes to rest in camp, the Levites are to erect it. Any unauthorized person who comes near must be put to death.

rows.hebrew: וַ/אֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה לָקַ֣חְתִּי אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם מִ/תּוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תַּ֧חַת כָּל בְּכ֛וֹר פֶּ֥טֶר רֶ֖חֶם מִ/בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הָ֥יוּ לִ֖/י הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
rows.fluent: “Look, I myself have taken the Levites from among the Israelites in place of every firstborn who opens the womb among them. The Levites will belong to me,

rows.hebrew: כִּ֣י לִ/י֮ כָּל בְּכוֹר֒ בְּ/יוֹם֩ הַכֹּתִ֨/י כָל בְּכ֜וֹר בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם הִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי לִ֤/י כָל בְּכוֹר֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵ/אָדָ֖ם עַד בְּהֵמָ֑ה לִ֥/י יִהְי֖וּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
rows.fluent: because every firstborn is mine. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I made every firstborn in Israel holy for myself, human and animal alike. They will belong to me. I am the LORD.”

rows.hebrew: כָּל פְּקוּדֵ֨י הַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְׄ/אַׄהֲׄרֹ֛ׄןׄ עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם כָּל זָכָר֙ מִ/בֶּן חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף
rows.fluent: The Levites registered by Moses and Aaron at the LORD’s direction, by their clans—all males one month old and upward—totaled 22,000.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יְהִי֩ כָל בְּכ֨וֹר זָכָ֜ר בְּ/מִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמ֛וֹת מִ/בֶּן חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָ/מַ֖עְלָ/ה לִ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֤יִם וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה וְ/שִׁבְעִ֖ים וּ/מָאתָֽיִם
rows.fluent: The firstborn males registered by name, one month old and upward, totaled 22,273.

rows.hebrew: קַ֣ח אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם תַּ֤חַת כָּל בְּכוֹר֙ בִּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אֶת בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם תַּ֣חַת בְּהֶמְתָּ֑/ם וְ/הָיוּ לִ֥/י הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
rows.fluent: “Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the Israelites, and the Levites’ livestock in place of their livestock. The Levites will belong to me. I am the LORD.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אֵת֙ פְּדוּיֵ֣י הַ/שְּׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְ/הַ/שִּׁבְעִ֖ים וְ/הַ/מָּאתָ֑יִם הָ/עֹֽדְפִים֙ עַל הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם מִ/בְּכ֖וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
rows.fluent: To redeem the 273 Israelite firstborn who exceed the number of the Levites,

rows.hebrew: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֗ חֲמֵ֧שֶׁת חֲמֵ֛שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים לַ/גֻּלְגֹּ֑לֶת בְּ/שֶׁ֤קֶל הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ תִּקָּ֔ח עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הַ/שָּֽׁקֶל
rows.fluent: collect five shekels for each person, using the sanctuary shekel, which is twenty gerahs.

rows.hebrew: מֵ/אֵ֗ת בְּכ֛וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָקַ֣ח אֶת הַ/כָּ֑סֶף חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֜ים וּ/שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וָ/אֶ֖לֶף בְּ/שֶׁ֥קֶל הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
rows.fluent: He collected 1,365 shekels of silver from the Israelite firstborn, measured by the sanctuary shekel.

rows.hebrew: מִ/בֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה וְ/עַ֖ד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל בָּא֙ לַ/צָּבָ֔א לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
rows.fluent: from thirty years old up to fifty—all who enter the service to work at the tent of meeting.

rows.hebrew: מִ/בֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה וְ/עַ֖ד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל הַ/בָּ֗א לַ/עֲבֹ֨ד עֲבֹדַ֧ת עֲבֹדָ֛ה וַ/עֲבֹדַ֥ת מַשָּׂ֖א בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
rows.fluent: from thirty years old up to fifty, all who entered the service to do the work and carry the loads of the tent of meeting.

rows.hebrew: וָ/אֶתְּנָ֨/ה אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם נְתֻנִ֣ים לְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּ/לְ/בָנָ֗י/ו מִ/תּוֹךְ֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לַ/עֲבֹ֞ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּ/לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר עַל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹ֨א יִהְיֶ֜ה בִּ/בְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נֶ֔גֶף בְּ/גֶ֥שֶׁת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
rows.fluent: From among the Israelites I have given the Levites to Aaron and his sons as a gift. They are to do the Israelites’ work at the tent of meeting and make atonement for the Israelites, so no plague strikes the Israelites when the Israelites approach the sanctuary.”

rows.hebrew: זֹ֖את אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם מִ/בֶּן֩ חָמֵ֨שׁ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה יָבוֹא֙ לִ/צְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א בַּ/עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
rows.fluent: “This is the rule for the Levites: from the age of twenty-five, a man is to join the company serving at the tent of meeting.

rows.hebrew: וּ/מִ/בֶּן֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב מִ/צְּבָ֣א הָ/עֲבֹדָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א יַעֲבֹ֖ד עֽוֹד
rows.fluent: At fifty he must withdraw from that company’s work and no longer perform it.

rows.hebrew: וְ/שֵׁרֵ֨ת אֶת אֶחָ֜י/ו בְּ/אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ לִ/שְׁמֹ֣ר מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וַ/עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א יַעֲבֹ֑ד כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם בְּ/מִשְׁמְרֹתָֽ/ם
rows.fluent: He may assist his fellow Levites at the tent of meeting in keeping its charge, but he must not perform the work. This is how you are to arrange the Levites’ duties.”

rows.hebrew: וְ/יָרַדְתִּ֗י וְ/דִבַּרְתִּ֣י עִמְּ/ךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְ/אָצַלְתִּ֗י מִן הָ/ר֛וּחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֣י עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/נָשְׂא֤וּ אִתְּ/ךָ֙ בְּ/מַשָּׂ֣א הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/לֹא תִשָּׂ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לְ/בַדֶּֽ/ךָ
rows.fluent: I will come down and speak with you there. I will take some of the spirit that is on you and place it on them. They will carry the people’s burden with you, so you will not carry it alone.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֵּ֨רֶד יְהוָ֥ה בֶּ/עָנָן֮ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָי/ו֒ וַ/יָּ֗אצֶל מִן הָ/ר֨וּחַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּתֵּ֕ן עַל שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ הַ/זְּקֵנִ֑ים וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/נ֤וֹחַ עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ הָ/ר֔וּחַ וַ/יִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ וְ/לֹ֥א יָסָֽפוּ
rows.fluent: The LORD came down in the cloud and spoke to Moses. He took some of the spirit that was on Moses and placed it on the seventy elders. When the spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did not do so again.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַֽ/מְקַנֵּ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לִ֑/י וּ/מִ֨י יִתֵּ֜ן כָּל עַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ נְבִיאִ֔ים כִּי יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת רוּח֖/וֹ עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
rows.fluent: Moses replied, “Are you jealous on my behalf? If only all the LORD’s people were prophets! If only the LORD would put his spirit on them!”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר שִׁמְעוּ נָ֣א דְבָרָ֑/י אִם יִֽהְיֶה֙ נְבִ֣יאֲ/כֶ֔ם יְהוָ֗ה בַּ/מַּרְאָה֙ אֵלָ֣י/ו אֶתְוַדָּ֔ע בַּ/חֲל֖וֹם אֲדַבֶּר בּֽ/וֹ
rows.fluent: He said, “Listen to my words: If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, make myself known to them in a vision; I speak to them in a dream.

rows.hebrew: לֹא כֵ֖ן עַבְדִּ֣/י מֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּ/כָל בֵּיתִ֖/י נֶאֱמָ֥ן הֽוּא
rows.fluent: That is not how it is with my servant Moses. He is trusted throughout my house.

rows.hebrew: פֶּ֣ה אֶל פֶּ֞ה אֲדַבֶּר בּ֗/וֹ וּ/מַרְאֶה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א בְ/חִידֹ֔ת וּ/תְמֻנַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה יַבִּ֑יט וּ/מַדּ֨וּעַ֙ לֹ֣א יְרֵאתֶ֔ם לְ/דַבֵּ֖ר בְּ/עַבְדִּ֥/י בְ/מֹשֶֽׁה
rows.fluent: With him I speak mouth to mouth, plainly, not in riddles. He beholds the form of the LORD. Why, then, were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?”

rows.hebrew: לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה אֶפְרָ֖יִם הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן נֽוּן
rows.fluent: Ephraim’s tribe, Hoshea son of Nun;

rows.hebrew: אֵ֚לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָ/ת֣וּר אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה לְ/הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן נ֖וּן יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ
rows.fluent: Those were the men Moses sent to scout the land. Moses gave Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יִּפְּל֤וּ עַל פְּנֵי/הֶם֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֕ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָ/רוּחֹ֖ת לְ/כָל בָּשָׂ֑ר הָ/אִ֤ישׁ אֶחָד֙ יֶחֱטָ֔א וְ/עַ֥ל כָּל הָ/עֵדָ֖ה תִּקְצֹֽף
rows.fluent: They fell facedown and said, “God, God of the spirits of all flesh, will you be angry with the whole community when one man sins?”

rows.hebrew: יִפְקֹ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָ/רוּחֹ֖ת לְ/כָל בָּשָׂ֑ר אִ֖ישׁ עַל הָ/עֵדָֽה
rows.fluent: “May the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the community,

rows.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵ֣א לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֗ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָבֹא֙ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹצִיאֵ֖/ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְבִיאֵ֑/ם וְ/לֹ֤א תִהְיֶה֙ עֲדַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/צֹּ֕אן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין לָ/הֶ֖ם רֹעֶֽה
rows.fluent: one who will go out before them and come in before them, who will lead them out and bring them in, so that the LORD’s community will not be like sheep without a shepherd.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה קַח לְ/ךָ֙ אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֔וּן אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר ר֣וּחַ בּ֑/וֹ וְ/סָמַכְתָּ֥ אֶת יָדְ/ךָ֖ עָלָֽי/ו
rows.fluent: The LORD told Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man with spirit in him, and lay your hand on him.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֗/וֹ לִ/פְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֖י כָּל הָ/עֵדָ֑ה וְ/צִוִּיתָ֥ה אֹת֖/וֹ לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
rows.fluent: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole community, and commission him in their sight.

rows.hebrew: וְ/נָתַתָּ֥ה מֵ/הֽוֹדְ/ךָ֖ עָלָ֑י/ו לְמַ֣עַן יִשְׁמְע֔וּ כָּל עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
rows.fluent: Give him some of your authority, so that the whole Israelite community will obey him.

rows.hebrew: וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְ/שָׁ֥אַל ל֛/וֹ בְּ/מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הָ/אוּרִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַל פִּ֨י/ו יֵצְא֜וּ וְ/עַל פִּ֣י/ו יָבֹ֗אוּ ה֛וּא וְ/כָל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אִתּ֖/וֹ וְ/כָל הָ/עֵדָֽה
rows.fluent: He is to stand before Eleazar the priest, who will seek a decision for him before the LORD by means of the Urim. At his word they will go out, and at his word they will come in—Joshua, all the Israelites with him, the whole community.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַ/יַּֽעֲמִדֵ֨/הוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֖י כָּל הָ/עֵדָֽה
rows.fluent: Moses did as the LORD commanded. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole community.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יִּסְמֹ֧ךְ אֶת יָדָ֛י/ו עָלָ֖י/ו וַ/יְצַוֵּ֑/הוּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
rows.fluent: He laid his hands on Joshua and commissioned him, as the LORD had directed through Moses.

rows.hebrew: צַ֚ו אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וִֽ/ישַׁלְּחוּ֙ מִן הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה כָּל צָר֖וּעַ וְ/כָל זָ֑ב וְ/כֹ֖ל טָמֵ֥א לָ/נָֽפֶשׁ
rows.fluent: “Command the Israelites to send out of the camp everyone with a defiling skin condition, everyone with a bodily discharge, and everyone made unclean by a dead person.

rows.hebrew: מִ/זָּכָ֤ר עַד נְקֵבָה֙ תְּשַׁלֵּ֔חוּ אֶל מִ/ח֥וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה תְּשַׁלְּח֑וּ/ם וְ/לֹ֤א יְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת מַ֣חֲנֵי/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
rows.fluent: Send them out, male and female alike. Send them outside the camp so that they do not make their camps unclean, for I dwell among them.”

rows.hebrew: דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּ֤י יַעֲשׂוּ֙ מִ/כָּל חַטֹּ֣את הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם לִ/מְעֹ֥ל מַ֖עַל בַּ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/אָֽשְׁמָ֖ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִֽוא
rows.fluent: “Tell the Israelites: When a man or woman commits any of the sins people commit, breaking faith with the LORD, that person incurs guilt.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הִתְוַדּ֗וּ אֶֽת חַטָּאתָ/ם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂוּ֒ וְ/הֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת אֲשָׁמ/וֹ֙ בְּ/רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וַ/חֲמִישִׁת֖/וֹ יֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/נָתַ֕ן לַ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָשַׁ֥ם לֽ/וֹ
rows.fluent: They must confess the sin they committed, make full restitution, add one-fifth to it, and give it to the person they wronged.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם אֵ֨ין לָ/אִ֜ישׁ גֹּאֵ֗ל לְ/הָשִׁ֤יב הָ/אָשָׁם֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו הָ/אָשָׁ֛ם הַ/מּוּשָׁ֥ב לַ/יהוָ֖ה לַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן מִ/לְּ/בַ֗ד אֵ֚יל הַ/כִּפֻּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר בּ֖/וֹ עָלָֽי/ו
rows.fluent: If the wronged person has no family redeemer to receive the restitution, it is to be paid to the LORD for the priest. This is in addition to the ram used to make atonement for the guilty person.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יְהִ֣י אֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ טְמֵאִים֙ לְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם וְ/לֹא יָכְל֥וּ לַ/עֲשֹׂת הַ/פֶּ֖סַח בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַֽ/יִּקְרְב֞וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
rows.fluent: But some men were unclean because of a dead person and could not keep the Passover that day. That same day they came before Moses and Aaron.

rows.hebrew: וַ֠/יֹּאמְרוּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו אֲנַ֥חְנוּ טְמֵאִ֖ים לְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם לָ֣/מָּה נִגָּרַ֗ע לְ/בִלְתִּ֨י הַקְרִ֜ב אֶת קָרְבַּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּ/מֹ֣עֲד֔/וֹ בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
rows.fluent: They said to Moses, “We are unclean because of a dead person. Why should we be kept from bringing the LORD’s offering at its appointed time with the rest of Israel?”

rows.hebrew: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ אִ֣ישׁ כִּי יִהְיֶֽה טָמֵ֣א לָ/נֶ֡פֶשׁ אוֹ֩ בְ/דֶ֨רֶךְ רְחֹקָ֜הׄ לָ/כֶ֗ם א֚וֹ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/עָ֥שָׂה פֶ֖סַח לַ/יהוָֽה
rows.fluent: “Tell the Israelites: ‘Anyone among you or your descendants who is unclean because of a dead person, or away on a distant journey, may still keep the Passover for the LORD.

rows.hebrew: בַּ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֜י בְּ/אַרְבָּעָ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם בֵּ֥ין הָ/עַרְבַּ֖יִם יַעֲשׂ֣וּ אֹת֑/וֹ עַל מַצּ֥וֹת וּ/מְרֹרִ֖ים יֹאכְלֻֽ/הוּ
rows.fluent: They are to keep it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month, eating it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הָ/אִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁר ה֨וּא טָה֜וֹר וּ/בְ/דֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא הָיָ֗ה וְ/חָדַל֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת הַ/פֶּ֔סַח וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מֵֽ/עַמֶּ֑י/הָ כִּ֣י קָרְבַּ֣ן יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֤א הִקְרִיב֙ בְּ/מֹ֣עֲד֔/וֹ חֶטְא֥/וֹ יִשָּׂ֖א הָ/אִ֥ישׁ הַ/הֽוּא
rows.fluent: But anyone who is clean and not away on a journey, yet fails to keep the Passover, will be cut off from their people. They did not bring the LORD’s offering at its appointed time; they must bear their sin.

rows.hebrew: וְ/כִֽי יָג֨וּר אִתְּ/כֶ֜ם גֵּ֗ר וְ/עָ֤שָֽׂה פֶ֨סַח֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה כְּ/חֻקַּ֥ת הַ/פֶּ֛סַח וּ/כְ/מִשְׁפָּט֖/וֹ כֵּ֣ן יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה חֻקָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לַ/גֵּ֖ר וּ/לְ/אֶזְרַ֥ח הָ/אָֽרֶץ
rows.fluent: If a resident foreigner lives among you and keeps the Passover for the LORD, that person must follow its statutes and regulations. You are to have one rule for the resident foreigner and the native-born alike.’”

rows.hebrew: הַ/קָּהָ֕ל חֻקָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָ/כֶ֖ם וְ/לַ/גֵּ֣ר הַ/גָּ֑ר חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם כָּ/כֶ֛ם כַּ/גֵּ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
rows.fluent: The community must have one rule for you and for the foreigner living among you, a lasting rule throughout your generations. You and the foreigner stand alike before the LORD.

rows.hebrew: תּוֹרָ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֥ט אֶחָ֖ד יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם וְ/לַ/גֵּ֖ר הַ/גָּ֥ר אִתְּ/כֶֽם
rows.fluent: You and the foreigner living among you must have the same instruction and the same ruling.”

rows.hebrew: הָֽ/אֶזְרָח֙ בִּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/לַ/גֵּ֖ר הַ/גָּ֣ר בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/ם תּוֹרָ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם לָ/עֹשֶׂ֖ה בִּ/שְׁגָגָֽה
rows.fluent: The same instruction applies to anyone who acts unintentionally, whether a native-born Israelite or a foreigner living among you.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הַ/נֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶֽׁר תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בְּ/יָ֣ד רָמָ֗ה מִן הָֽ/אֶזְרָח֙ וּ/מִן הַ/גֵּ֔ר אֶת יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא מְגַדֵּ֑ף וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽ/הּ
rows.fluent: But anyone who acts with a raised hand, whether native-born or a foreigner, insults the LORD. That person must be cut off from their people.

rows.hebrew: כִּ֤י דְבַר יְהוָה֙ בָּזָ֔ה וְ/אֶת מִצְוָת֖/וֹ הֵפַ֑ר הִכָּרֵ֧ת תִּכָּרֵ֛ת הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא עֲוֺנָ֥/ה בָֽ/הּ
rows.fluent: They have despised the LORD’s word and broken his command. That person must certainly be cut off; their guilt remains on them.”

rows.hebrew: וְ/אָסַ֣ף אִ֣ישׁ טָה֗וֹר אֵ֚ת אֵ֣פֶר הַ/פָּרָ֔ה וְ/הִנִּ֛יחַ מִ/ח֥וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה בְּ/מָק֣וֹם טָה֑וֹר וְ֠/הָיְתָה לַ/עֲדַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לְ/מִשְׁמֶ֛רֶת לְ/מֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה חַטָּ֥את הִֽוא
rows.fluent: A clean man must gather the cow’s ashes and place them outside the camp in a clean place. They are to be kept for the Israelite community to make water for removing impurity. It is a purification offering.

rows.hebrew: הַ/נֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּ/מֵ֖ת לְ/כָל נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם וְ/טָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
rows.fluent: Anyone who touches a human corpse will be unclean for seven days.

rows.hebrew: ה֣וּא יִתְחַטָּא ב֞/וֹ בַּ/יּ֧וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֛י וּ/בַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י יִטְהָ֑ר וְ/אִם לֹ֨א יִתְחַטָּ֜א בַּ/יּ֧וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֛י וּ/בַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י לֹ֥א יִטְהָֽר
rows.fluent: They must purify themselves with this water on the third day, and on the seventh day they will be clean. If they do not purify themselves on the third day, they will not be clean on the seventh day.

rows.hebrew: כָּֽל הַ/נֹּגֵ֡עַ בְּ/מֵ֣ת בְּ/נֶפֶשׁ֩ הָ/אָדָ֨ם אֲשֶׁר יָמ֜וּת וְ/לֹ֣א יִתְחַטָּ֗א אֶת מִשְׁכַּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ טִמֵּ֔א וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּי֩ מֵ֨י נִדָּ֜ה לֹא זֹרַ֤ק עָלָי/ו֙ טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה ע֖וֹד טֻמְאָת֥/וֹ בֽ/וֹ
rows.fluent: Anyone who touches a dead human body and does not purify themselves defiles the LORD’s tabernacle. That person must be cut off from Israel. Because the water for removing impurity was not sprinkled on them, they remain unclean; their impurity is still on them.

rows.hebrew: וְ/לָקַ֨ח אֵז֜וֹב וְ/טָבַ֣ל בַּ/מַּיִם֮ אִ֣ישׁ טָהוֹר֒ וְ/הִזָּ֤ה עַל הָ/אֹ֨הֶל֙ וְ/עַל כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים וְ/עַל הַ/נְּפָשׁ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָֽיוּ שָׁ֑ם וְ/עַל הַ/נֹּגֵ֗עַ בַּ/עֶ֨צֶם֙ א֣וֹ בֶֽ/חָלָ֔ל א֥וֹ בַ/מֵּ֖ת א֥וֹ בַ/קָּֽבֶר
rows.fluent: A clean man must take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle the tent, all the articles in it and the people who were there. He must also sprinkle anyone who touched a human bone, someone killed, another dead body or a grave.
rows.fluent_before_consistency: A clean man must take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle the tent, all its containers and the people who were there. He must also sprinkle anyone who touched a human bone, someone killed, another dead body or a grave.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הִזָּ֤ה הַ/טָּהֹר֙ עַל הַ/טָּמֵ֔א בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֖י וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֑י וְ/חִטְּא/וֹ֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י וְ/כִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָהֵ֥ר בָּ/עָֽרֶב
rows.fluent: The clean person must sprinkle the unclean person on the third and seventh days, purifying them on the seventh day. The person being purified must wash their clothes and bathe in water; at evening they will be clean.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִ֤ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִתְחַטָּ֔א וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/קָּהָ֑ל כִּי֩ אֶת מִקְדַּ֨שׁ יְהוָ֜ה טִמֵּ֗א מֵ֥י נִדָּ֛ה לֹא זֹרַ֥ק עָלָ֖י/ו טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא
rows.fluent: Anyone who becomes unclean and does not purify themselves must be cut off from the assembly for defiling the LORD’s sanctuary. The water for removing impurity has not been sprinkled on them; they are unclean.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה לָּ/הֶ֖ם לְ/חֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּ/מַזֵּ֤ה מֵֽי הַ/נִּדָּה֙ יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וְ/הַ/נֹּגֵ֨עַ֙ בְּ/מֵ֣י הַ/נִּדָּ֔ה יִטְמָ֖א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
rows.fluent: This is a lasting rule for them. The person who sprinkles the water for removing impurity must wash their clothes, and anyone who touches that water will be unclean until evening.

rows.hebrew: וְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בּ֥/וֹ הַ/טָּמֵ֖א יִטְמָ֑א וְ/הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/נֹּגַ֖עַת תִּטְמָ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
rows.fluent: Whatever the unclean person touches becomes unclean, and anyone who touches it will be unclean until evening.”

rows.hebrew: וְ/אַתֶּ֗ם חֲנ֛וּ מִ/ח֥וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כֹּל֩ הֹרֵ֨ג נֶ֜פֶשׁ וְ/כֹ֣ל נֹגֵ֣עַ בֶּֽ/חָלָ֗ל תִּֽתְחַטְּא֞וּ בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁי֙ וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י אַתֶּ֖ם וּ/שְׁבִי/כֶֽם
rows.fluent: Stay outside the camp for seven days. All of you who have killed someone or touched a slain person must purify yourselves on the third and seventh days—you and your captives alike.

rows.hebrew: וְ/כָל בֶּ֧גֶד וְ/כָל כְּלִי ע֛וֹר וְ/כָל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה עִזִּ֖ים וְ/כָל כְּלִי עֵ֑ץ תִּתְחַטָּֽאוּ
rows.fluent: Purify every garment, every leather article, everything made of goats’ hair and every wooden article.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֶל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/צָּבָ֔א הַ/בָּאִ֖ים לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַ/תּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
rows.fluent: Then Eleazar the priest told the soldiers who had gone to war, “This is the rule of the law that the LORD commanded Moses.

rows.hebrew: אַ֥ךְ אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֖ב וְ/אֶת הַ/כָּ֑סֶף אֶֽת הַ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֶת הַ/בַּרְזֶ֔ל אֶֽת הַ/בְּדִ֖יל וְ/אֶת הָ/עֹפָֽרֶת
rows.fluent: Gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin and lead—

rows.hebrew: כָּל דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר יָבֹ֣א בָ/אֵ֗שׁ תַּעֲבִ֤ירוּ בָ/אֵשׁ֙ וְ/טָהֵ֔ר אַ֕ךְ בְּ/מֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה יִתְחַטָּ֑א וְ/כֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יָבֹ֛א בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ בַ/מָּֽיִם
rows.fluent: anything that can withstand fire must pass through fire and be purified. It must also be purified with the water for removing impurity. Whatever cannot withstand fire must pass through water.

rows.hebrew: וְ/כִבַּסְתֶּ֧ם בִּגְדֵי/כֶ֛ם בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י וּ/טְהַרְתֶּ֑ם וְ/אַחַ֖ר תָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
rows.fluent: Wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you will be clean. After that you may enter the camp.”

rows.hebrew: וְ/הִקְרִיתֶ֤ם לָ/כֶם֙ עָרִ֔ים עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לָ/כֶ֑ם וְ/נָ֥ס שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ רֹצֵ֔חַ מַכֵּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּ/שְׁגָגָֽה
rows.fluent: designate towns as places of refuge for yourselves, where someone who has killed a person unintentionally can flee.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הָי֨וּ לָ/כֶ֧ם הֶ/עָרִ֛ים לְ/מִקְלָ֖ט מִ/גֹּאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹ֤א יָמוּת֙ הָ/רֹצֵ֔חַ עַד עָמְד֛/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/עֵדָ֖ה לַ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
rows.fluent: They will be places of refuge from the avenger, so that the killer does not die before standing trial before the community.

rows.hebrew: לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/לַ/גֵּ֤ר וְ/לַ/תּוֹשָׁב֙ בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/ם תִּהְיֶ֛ינָה שֵׁשׁ הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה לְ/מִקְלָ֑ט לָ/נ֣וּס שָׁ֔מָּ/ה כָּל מַכֵּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּ/שְׁגָגָֽה
rows.fluent: These six towns will be a refuge for the Israelites and for the foreigner and settler among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.

rows.hebrew: גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ/דָּ֔ם ה֥וּא יָמִ֖ית אֶת הָ/רֹצֵ֑חַ בְּ/פִגְע/וֹ ב֖/וֹ ה֥וּא יְמִיתֶֽ/נּוּ
rows.fluent: The avenger of blood himself is to put the murderer to death. When he encounters the murderer, he is to kill him.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם בְּ/שִׂנְאָ֖ה יֶהְדָּפֶ֑/נּוּ אֽוֹ הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ עָלָ֛י/ו בִּ/צְדִיָּ֖ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
rows.fluent: If someone pushes a person out of hatred, or deliberately throws something at a person and the person dies,

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם בְּ/פֶ֥תַע בְּ/לֹא אֵיבָ֖ה הֲדָפ֑/וֹ אוֹ הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ עָלָ֛י/ו כָּל כְּלִ֖י בְּ/לֹ֥א צְדִיָּֽה
rows.fluent: But if someone suddenly pushes a person without hostility, or throws any object at a person without intending harm,

rows.hebrew: א֣וֹ בְ/כָל אֶ֜בֶן אֲשֶׁר יָמ֥וּת בָּ/הּ֙ בְּ/לֹ֣א רְא֔וֹת וַ/יַּפֵּ֥ל עָלָ֖י/ו וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת וְ/הוּא֙ לֹא אוֹיֵ֣ב ל֔/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ רָעָתֽ/וֹ
rows.fluent: or drops a stone capable of killing on someone without seeing them, and the person dies, though the killer was not an enemy and did not seek their harm,

rows.hebrew: וְ/שָֽׁפְטוּ֙ הָֽ/עֵדָ֔ה בֵּ֚ין הַ/מַּכֶּ֔ה וּ/בֵ֖ין גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ/דָּ֑ם עַ֥ל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
rows.fluent: then the community must judge between the one who struck the blow and the avenger of blood according to these rules.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הִצִּ֨ילוּ הָ/עֵדָ֜ה אֶת הָ/רֹצֵ֗חַ מִ/יַּד֮ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ/דָּם֒ וְ/הֵשִׁ֤יבוּ אֹת/וֹ֙ הָֽ/עֵדָ֔ה אֶל עִ֥יר מִקְלָט֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁר נָ֣ס שָׁ֑מָּ/ה וְ/יָ֣שַׁב בָּ֗/הּ עַד מוֹת֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּדֹ֔ל אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/שֶׁ֥מֶן הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
rows.fluent: The community must rescue the killer from the avenger of blood and return the killer to the refuge town where they fled. The killer must stay there until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.

rows.hebrew: וּ/מָצָ֤א אֹת/וֹ֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ/דָּ֔ם מִ/ח֕וּץ לִ/גְב֖וּל עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑/וֹ וְ/רָצַ֞ח גֹּאֵ֤ל הַ/דָּם֙ אֶת הָ֣/רֹצֵ֔חַ אֵ֥ין ל֖/וֹ דָּֽם
rows.fluent: and the avenger of blood finds the killer outside that boundary and kills them, the avenger bears no bloodguilt.

rows.hebrew: כִּ֣י בְ/עִ֤יר מִקְלָט/וֹ֙ יֵשֵׁ֔ב עַד מ֖וֹת הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּדֹ֑ל וְ/אַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹת֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּדֹ֔ל יָשׁוּב֙ הָ/רֹצֵ֔חַ אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתֽ/וֹ
rows.fluent: The killer must stay in the refuge town until the high priest dies. After the high priest’s death, the killer may return to the land they hold.

rows.hebrew: כָּל מַ֨כֵּה נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְ/פִ֣י עֵדִ֔ים יִרְצַ֖ח אֶת הָ/רֹצֵ֑חַ וְ/עֵ֣ד אֶחָ֔ד לֹא יַעֲנֶ֥ה בְ/נֶ֖פֶשׁ לָ/מֽוּת
rows.fluent: A person who commits murder is to be put to death on the testimony of witnesses. But a single witness cannot testify against someone to have that person put to death.
rows.fluent_before_consistency: A murderer is to be put to death for killing a person on the testimony of witnesses. But a single witness cannot testify against someone to have that person put to death.

rows.hebrew: וְ/לֹֽא תִקְח֥וּ כֹ֨פֶר֙ לְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ רֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר ה֥וּא רָשָׁ֖ע לָ/מ֑וּת כִּי מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת
rows.fluent: Do not accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die. The murderer must be put to death.

rows.hebrew: וְ/לֹא תִקְח֣וּ כֹ֔פֶר לָ/נ֖וּס אֶל עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑/וֹ לָ/שׁוּב֙ לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ עַד מ֖וֹת הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
rows.fluent: And do not accept a ransom for someone who has fled to a refuge town, allowing them to return and live on their land before the priest dies.

rows.hebrew: וְ/לֹֽא תַחֲנִ֣יפוּ אֶת הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ בָּ֔/הּ כִּ֣י הַ/דָּ֔ם ה֥וּא יַחֲנִ֖יף אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/לָ/אָ֣רֶץ לֹֽא יְכֻפַּ֗ר לַ/דָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שֻׁפַּךְ בָּ֔/הּ כִּי אִ֖ם בְּ/דַ֥ם שֹׁפְכֽ/וֹ
rows.fluent: Do not pollute the land where you are, for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for blood shed on it except by the blood of the one who shed it.

rows.hebrew: וְ/לֹ֧א תְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּ֔/הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ן בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/הּ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁכֵ֕ן בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
rows.fluent: Do not defile the land where you live, where I dwell, for I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.”

rows.hebrew: וּ/צְלָפְחָ֣ד בֶּן חֵ֗פֶר לֹא הָ֥יוּ ל֛/וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם בָּנ֑וֹת וְ/שֵׁם֙ בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֔ד מַחְלָ֣ה וְ/נֹעָ֔ה חָגְלָ֥ה מִלְכָּ֖ה וְ/תִרְצָֽה
rows.fluent: Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, only daughters. Their names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.

rows.hebrew: אֵ֗לֶּה פְּקוּדֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וָ/אָ֑לֶף שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּ/שְׁלֹשִֽׁים
rows.fluent: The total number of Israelites counted was six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.

rows.hebrew: לָ/רַ֗ב תַּרְבֶּה֙ נַחֲלָת֔/וֹ וְ/לַ/מְעַ֕ט תַּמְעִ֖יט נַחֲלָת֑/וֹ אִ֚ישׁ לְ/פִ֣י פְקֻדָ֔י/ו יֻתַּ֖ן נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ
rows.fluent: Give a larger inheritance to a larger group and a smaller inheritance to a smaller group. Each group is to receive its inheritance according to its census total.

rows.hebrew: אַךְ בְּ/גוֹרָ֕ל יֵחָלֵ֖ק אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לִ/שְׁמ֥וֹת מַטּוֹת אֲבֹתָ֖/ם יִנְחָֽלוּ
rows.fluent: But the land must be divided by lot. They are to receive their inheritance according to the names of their ancestral tribes.

rows.hebrew: עַל פִּי֙ הַ/גּוֹרָ֔ל תֵּחָלֵ֖ק נַחֲלָת֑/וֹ בֵּ֥ין רַ֖ב לִ/מְעָֽט
rows.fluent: The lot will decide how the inheritance is divided between the larger and smaller groups.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף כָּל זָכָ֖ר מִ/בֶּן חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה כִּ֣י לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֗וּ בְּ/תוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י לֹא נִתַּ֤ן לָ/הֶם֙ נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
rows.fluent: The Levite census totaled twenty-three thousand males, counting everyone one month old and up. They were not counted with the other Israelites, because they received no inheritance among them.

rows.hebrew: וּ/בְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ לֹא הָ֣יָה אִ֔ישׁ מִ/פְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקְד֛וּ אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי
rows.fluent: Among them was no one from the earlier census taken by Moses and Aaron the priest in the wilderness of Sinai.

rows.hebrew: כִּֽי אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם מ֥וֹת יָמֻ֖תוּ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וְ/לֹא נוֹתַ֤ר מֵ/הֶם֙ אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֚י אִם כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נֽוּן
rows.fluent: The LORD had said that they would certainly die in the wilderness. Not one of them remained except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

rows.hebrew: וַ/תִּקְרַ֜בְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֗ד בֶּן חֵ֤פֶר בֶּן גִּלְעָד֙ בֶּן מָכִ֣יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן יוֹסֵ֑ף וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֹתָ֔י/ו מַחְלָ֣ה נֹעָ֔ה וְ/חָגְלָ֥ה וּ/מִלְכָּ֖ה וְ/תִרְצָֽה
rows.fluent: The daughters of Zelophehad came forward. He was the son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, from the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. His daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.

rows.hebrew: וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֜דְנָה לִ/פְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְ/לִ/פְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/נְּשִׂיאִ֖ם וְ/כָל הָ/עֵדָ֑ה פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לֵ/אמֹֽר
rows.fluent: They stood at the entrance of the tent of meeting before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders and the whole community. They said,

rows.hebrew: אָבִי/נוּ֮ מֵ֣ת בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֒ וְ/ה֨וּא לֹא הָיָ֜ה בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עֵדָ֗ה הַ/נּוֹעָדִ֛ים עַל יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/עֲדַת קֹ֑רַח כִּֽי בְ/חֶטְא֣/וֹ מֵ֔ת וּ/בָנִ֖ים לֹא הָ֥יוּ לֽ/וֹ
rows.fluent: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not part of Korah’s company, which gathered against the LORD. He died for his own sin, and he had no sons.

rows.hebrew: לָ֣/מָּה יִגָּרַ֤ע שֵׁם אָבִ֨י/נוּ֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֔/וֹ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין ל֖/וֹ בֵּ֑ן תְּנָ/ה לָּ֣/נוּ אֲחֻזָּ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֥י אָבִֽי/נוּ
rows.fluent: Why should our father’s name disappear from his clan because he had no son? Give us a landholding among our father’s brothers.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יַּקְרֵ֥ב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת מִשְׁפָּטָ֖/ן לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
rows.fluent: Moses brought their case before the LORD.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
rows.fluent: The LORD answered Moses:

rows.hebrew: כֵּ֗ן בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָד֮ דֹּבְרֹת֒ נָתֹ֨ן תִּתֵּ֤ן לָ/הֶם֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֣י אֲבִי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הַֽעֲבַרְתָּ֛ אֶת נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבִי/הֶ֖ן לָ/הֶֽן
rows.fluent: “Zelophehad’s daughters are right. You must give them a landholding as an inheritance among their father’s brothers. Transfer their father’s inheritance to them.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ כִּֽי יָמ֗וּת וּ/בֵן֙ אֵ֣ין ל֔/וֹ וְ/הַֽעֲבַרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת נַחֲלָת֖/וֹ לְ/בִתּֽ/וֹ
rows.fluent: Tell the Israelites: ‘If a man dies without a son, transfer his inheritance to his daughter.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם אֵ֥ין ל֖/וֹ בַּ֑ת וּ/נְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת נַחֲלָת֖/וֹ לְ/אֶחָי/ו
rows.fluent: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם אֵ֥ין ל֖/וֹ אַחִ֑ים וּ/נְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת נַחֲלָת֖/וֹ לַ/אֲחֵ֥י אָבִֽי/ו
rows.fluent: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם אֵ֣ין אַחִים֮ לְ/אָבִי/ו֒ וּ/נְתַתֶּ֣ם אֶת נַחֲלָת֗/וֹ לִ/שְׁאֵר֞/וֹ הַ/קָּרֹ֥ב אֵלָ֛י/ו מִ/מִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖/וֹ וְ/יָרַ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑/הּ וְֽ/הָ֨יְתָ֜ה לִ/בְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ/חֻקַּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֔ט כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
rows.fluent: If his father has no brothers, give the inheritance to his nearest relative in his clan, who will take possession of it.’ This is to be a binding rule for Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אִֽם תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ/ן אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה אִם תֵּחָֽלְצ֛וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
rows.fluent: Moses answered them, “If you do this—if you arm yourselves before the LORD for war,

rows.hebrew: וְ/עָבַ֨ר לָ/כֶ֧ם כָּל חָל֛וּץ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַ֧ד הוֹרִישׁ֛/וֹ אֶת אֹיְבָ֖י/ו מִ/פָּנָֽי/ו
rows.fluent: and every armed man among you crosses the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven his enemies out before him,

rows.hebrew: וְ/נִכְבְּשָׁ֨ה הָ/אָ֜רֶץ לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְ/אַחַ֣ר תָּשֻׁ֔בוּ וִ/הְיִיתֶ֧ם נְקִיִּ֛ים מֵ/יְהוָ֖ה וּ/מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠/הָיְתָה הָ/אָ֨רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֥את לָ/כֶ֛ם לַ/אֲחֻזָּ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
rows.fluent: and the land has been subdued before the LORD—then you may return, free of your obligation to the LORD and to Israel. This land will be your holding before the LORD.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם לֹ֤א תַעֲשׂוּ/ן֙ כֵּ֔ן הִנֵּ֥ה חֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַ/יהוָ֑ה וּ/דְעוּ֙ חַטַּאתְ/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּמְצָ֖א אֶתְ/כֶֽם
rows.fluent: But if you do not do this, you will have sinned against the LORD. Be sure that your sin will find you out.

rows.hebrew: בְּנֽוּ לָ/כֶ֤ם עָרִים֙ לְ/טַפְּ/כֶ֔ם וּ/גְדֵרֹ֖ת לְ/צֹנַאֲ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הַ/יֹּצֵ֥א מִ/פִּי/כֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ
rows.fluent: Build towns for your little children and pens for your flocks, and do what you have said you would do.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם אִם יַעַבְר֣וּ בְנֵי גָ֣ד וּ/בְנֵי רְאוּבֵ֣ן אִ֠תְּ/כֶם אֶֽת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֞ן כָּל חָל֤וּץ לַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/נִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֑ם וּ/נְתַתֶּ֥ם לָ/הֶ֛ם אֶת אֶ֥רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָ֖ד לַ/אֲחֻזָּֽה
rows.fluent: He told them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan with you, every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, give them Gilead as their holding.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם לֹ֧א יַֽעַבְר֛וּ חֲלוּצִ֖ים אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/נֹֽאחֲז֥וּ בְ/תֹכְ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
rows.fluent: But if they do not cross over armed with you, they must receive a holding among you in Canaan.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן לָ/הֶ֣ם מֹשֶׁ֡ה לִ/בְנֵי גָד֩ וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן וְ/לַ/חֲצִ֣י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן יוֹסֵ֗ף אֶת מַמְלֶ֨כֶת֙ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֔י וְ/אֶת מַמְלֶ֔כֶת ע֖וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֑ן הָ/אָ֗רֶץ לְ/עָרֶ֨י/הָ֙ בִּ/גְבֻלֹ֔ת עָרֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ סָבִֽיב
rows.fluent: Moses gave the Gadites, the Reubenites and half the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdoms of Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of Bashan: the land with its towns and their surrounding territory.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ בְּנֵ֨י מָכִ֧יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה גִּלְעָ֖דָ/ה וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדֻ֑/הָ וַ/יּ֖וֹרֶשׁ אֶת הָ/אֱמֹרִ֥י אֲשֶׁר בָּֽ/הּ
rows.fluent: The descendants of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead and captured it, driving out the Amorites who lived there.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הַ/גִּלְעָ֔ד לְ/מָכִ֖יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בָּֽ/הּ
rows.fluent: Moses gave Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and Machir’s family settled there.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הִתְנַחַלְתֶּם֩ אֶת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ בְּ/גוֹרָ֜ל לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹֽתֵי/כֶ֗ם לָ/רַ֞ב תַּרְבּ֤וּ אֶת נַחֲלָת/וֹ֙ וְ/לַ/מְעַט֙ תַּמְעִ֣יט אֶת נַחֲלָת֔/וֹ אֶל֩ אֲשֶׁר יֵ֨צֵא ל֥/וֹ שָׁ֛מָּ/ה הַ/גּוֹרָ֖ל ל֣/וֹ יִהְיֶ֑ה לְ/מַטּ֥וֹת אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם תִּתְנֶחָֽלוּ
rows.fluent: Divide the land by lot among your clans. Give a larger inheritance to a larger group and a smaller inheritance to a smaller group. Each group will have the place its lot falls on; take your inheritance according to your ancestral tribes.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם לֹ֨א תוֹרִ֜ישׁוּ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָרֶץ֮ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶם֒ וְ/הָיָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תּוֹתִ֣ירוּ מֵ/הֶ֔ם לְ/שִׂכִּים֙ בְּ/עֵ֣ינֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/לִ/צְנִינִ֖ם בְּ/צִדֵּי/כֶ֑ם וְ/צָרֲר֣וּ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם עַל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יֹשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽ/הּ
rows.fluent: But if you do not drive out the land’s inhabitants before you, those you leave will be barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land where you settle.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּמִּ֛יתִי לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ/הֶ֖ם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָ/כֶֽם
rows.fluent: And what I planned to do to them, I will do to you.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יְצַ֣ו מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר זֹ֣את הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּתְנַחֲל֤וּ אֹתָ/הּ֙ בְּ/גוֹרָ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לָ/תֵ֛ת לְ/תִשְׁעַ֥ת הַ/מַּטּ֖וֹת וַ/חֲצִ֥י הַ/מַּטֶּֽה
rows.fluent: Moses commanded the Israelites, “This is the land you are to receive as an inheritance by lot. The LORD has commanded that it be given to the nine tribes and the half-tribe.

rows.hebrew: כִּ֣י לָקְח֞וּ מַטֵּ֨ה בְנֵ֤י הָ/ראוּבֵנִי֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔/ם וּ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי הַ/גָּדִ֖י לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם וַ/חֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לָקְח֖וּ נַחֲלָתָֽ/ם
rows.fluent: The tribe of Reuben, by its ancestral houses, and the tribe of Gad, by its ancestral houses, have already received their inheritance, as has half the tribe of Manasseh.

rows.hebrew: שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/מַּטּ֖וֹת וַ/חֲצִ֣י הַ/מַּטֶּ֑ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗/ם מֵ/עֵ֛בֶר לְ/יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ קֵ֥דְמָ/ה מִזְרָֽחָ/ה
rows.fluent: Those two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance across the Jordan from Jericho, on the east, toward the sunrise.”

rows.hebrew: אֵ֚לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר יִנְחֲל֥וּ לָ/כֶ֖ם אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נֽוּן
rows.fluent: “These are the men who will assign the land to you as an inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.

rows.hebrew: וְ/נָשִׂ֥יא אֶחָ֛ד נָשִׂ֥יא אֶחָ֖ד מִ/מַּטֶּ֑ה תִּקְח֖וּ לִ/נְחֹ֥ל אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
rows.fluent: Take one leader from each tribe to assign the land as an inheritance.

rows.hebrew: וַֽ/יִּקְרְב֞וּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽ/אָב֗וֹת לְ/מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בְּנֵֽי גִלְעָד֙ בֶּן מָכִ֣יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה מִֽ/מִּשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַֽ/יְדַבְּר֞וּ לִ/פְנֵ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/נְּשִׂאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
rows.fluent: The heads of the ancestral houses in the clan of Gilead son of Machir, son of Manasseh, from the clans of Joseph’s descendants, came forward. They spoke before Moses and the leaders, the heads of the Israelites’ ancestral houses.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ אֶת אֲדֹנִ/י֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לָ/תֵ֨ת אֶת הָ/אָ֧רֶץ בְּ/נַחֲלָ֛ה בְּ/גוֹרָ֖ל לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/אדֹנִ/י֙ צֻוָּ֣ה בַֽ/יהוָ֔ה לָ/תֵ֗ת אֶֽת נַחֲלַ֛ת צְלָפְחָ֥ד אָחִ֖י/נוּ לִ/בְנֹתָֽי/ו
rows.fluent: They said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the Israelites the land as an inheritance by lot. My lord was also commanded by the LORD to give our brother Zelophehad’s inheritance to his daughters.

rows.hebrew: וְ֠/הָיוּ לְ/אֶחָ֞ד מִ/בְּנֵ֨י שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְ/נָשִׁים֒ וְ/נִגְרְעָ֤ה נַחֲלָתָ/ן֙ מִ/נַּחֲלַ֣ת אֲבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/נוֹסַ֕ף עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַ/מַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָ/הֶ֑ם וּ/מִ/גֹּרַ֥ל נַחֲלָתֵ֖/נוּ יִגָּרֵֽעַ
rows.fluent: If they marry men from another Israelite tribe, their inheritance will be taken away from our ancestors’ inheritance and added to the inheritance of the tribe they marry into. It will be taken away from our allotted inheritance.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם יִהְיֶ֣ה הַ/יֹּבֵל֮ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְ/נֽוֹסְפָה֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔/ן עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַ/מַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָ/הֶ֑ם וּ/מִֽ/נַּחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ יִגָּרַ֖ע נַחֲלָתָֽ/ן
rows.fluent: Even when the Israelites’ Jubilee comes, the women’s inheritance will belong to the tribe they marry into. Their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our ancestral tribe.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֵּ֛ן מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי יוֹסֵ֖ף דֹּבְרִֽים
rows.fluent: Then, at the LORD’s command, Moses instructed the Israelites: “The tribe of Joseph’s descendants is right in what it says.

rows.hebrew: זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה לִ/בְנ֤וֹת צְלָפְחָד֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לַ/טּ֥וֹב בְּ/עֵינֵי/הֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לְ/נָשִׁ֑ים אַ֗ךְ לְ/מִשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אֲבִי/הֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לְ/נָשִֽׁים
rows.fluent: This is what the LORD commands concerning Zelophehad’s daughters: They may marry whomever they think best, but only within a clan of their father’s tribe.

rows.hebrew: וְ/לֹֽא תִסֹּ֤ב נַחֲלָה֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/מַּטֶּ֖ה אֶל מַטֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י אִ֗ישׁ בְּ/נַחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו יִדְבְּק֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
rows.fluent: An inheritance must not pass from tribe to tribe among the Israelites. Each Israelite must hold on to the inheritance of their ancestral tribe.

rows.hebrew: וְ/כָל בַּ֞ת יֹרֶ֣שֶׁת נַחֲלָ֗ה מִ/מַּטּוֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְ/אֶחָ֗ד מִ/מִּשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אָבִ֖י/הָ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה לְמַ֗עַן יִֽירְשׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
rows.fluent: Every daughter who inherits land in an Israelite tribe must marry someone from a clan of her father’s tribe, so that each Israelite may retain their ancestral inheritance.

rows.hebrew: וְ/לֹֽא תִסֹּ֧ב נַחֲלָ֛ה מִ/מַּטֶּ֖ה לְ/מַטֶּ֣ה אַחֵ֑ר כִּי אִישׁ֙ בְּ/נַ֣חֲלָת֔/וֹ יִדְבְּק֕וּ מַטּ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
rows.fluent: No inheritance may pass from one tribe to another. Each Israelite tribe must hold on to its own inheritance.”

rows.hebrew: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנ֥וֹת צְלָפְחָֽד
rows.fluent: Zelophehad’s daughters did as the LORD had commanded Moses.

rows.hebrew: וַ/תִּהְיֶ֜ינָה מַחְלָ֣ה תִרְצָ֗ה וְ/חָגְלָ֧ה וּ/מִלְכָּ֛ה וְ/נֹעָ֖ה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֑ד לִ/בְנֵ֥י דֹדֵי/הֶ֖ן לְ/נָשִֽׁים
rows.fluent: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah and Noah, Zelophehad’s daughters, married sons of their father’s brothers.

rows.hebrew: מִֽ/מִּשְׁפְּחֹ֛ת בְּנֵֽי מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בֶן יוֹסֵ֖ף הָי֣וּ לְ/נָשִׁ֑ים וַ/תְּהִי֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔/ן עַל מַטֵּ֖ה מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת אֲבִי/הֶֽן
rows.fluent: They married within the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained with the tribe of their father’s clan.

rows.hebrew: אֵ֣לֶּה הַ/מִּצְוֺ֞ת וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּ/עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ
rows.fluent: These are the commands and rulings that the LORD gave the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.

rows.hebrew: יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה וְ/יִשְׁמְרֶֽ/ךָ
rows.fluent: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you;

rows.hebrew: יָאֵ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה פָּנָ֛י/ו אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ וִֽ/יחֻנֶּֽ/ךָּ
rows.fluent: may the LORD make his face shine on you and be gracious to you;

rows.hebrew: יִשָּׂ֨א יְהוָ֤ה פָּנָי/ו֙ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/יָשֵׂ֥ם לְ/ךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם
rows.fluent: may the LORD lift his face toward you and give you peace.’

rows.hebrew: וְ/שָׂמ֥וּ אֶת שְׁמִ֖/י עַל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/אֲנִ֖י אֲבָרֲכֵֽ/ם
rows.fluent: So they will place my name on the Israelites, and I myself will bless them.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יְהִ֛י בִּ/נְסֹ֥עַ הָ/אָרֹ֖ן וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֑ה קוּמָ֣/ה יְהוָ֗ה וְ/יָפֻ֨צוּ֙ אֹֽיְבֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/יָנֻ֥סוּ מְשַׂנְאֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
rows.fluent: Whenever the ark set out, Moses would say: “Rise, LORD! Let your enemies scatter; let those who hate you flee before you!”

rows.hebrew: וּ/בְ/נֻחֹ֖/ה יֹאמַ֑ר שׁוּבָ֣/ה יְהוָ֔ה רִֽבְב֖וֹת אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
rows.fluent: When the ark came to rest, he would say: “Return, LORD, to Israel’s myriads of thousands!”

rows.hebrew: יְהוָ֗ה אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֨יִם֙ וְ/רַב חֶ֔סֶד נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֖ן וָ/פָ֑שַׁע וְ/נַקֵּה֙ לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֞ד עֲוֺ֤ן אָבוֹת֙ עַל בָּנִ֔ים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְ/עַל רִבֵּעִֽים
rows.fluent: ‘The LORD is slow to anger, abounding in faithful love, forgiving guilt and rebellion, yet certainly not clearing the guilty, bringing the fathers’ guilt upon their children, to the third and fourth generations.’

rows.hebrew: סְלַֽח נָ֗א לַ/עֲוֺ֛ן הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה כְּ/גֹ֣דֶל חַסְדֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתָה֙ לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה מִ/מִּצְרַ֖יִם וְ/עַד הֵֽנָּה
rows.fluent: Please forgive these people’s wrongdoing in keeping with your great faithful love, just as you have borne with them from Egypt until now.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה סָלַ֖חְתִּי כִּ/דְבָרֶֽ/ךָ
rows.fluent: The LORD replied, “I have forgiven them, as you asked.

rows.hebrew: פִּֽינְחָ֨ס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֜ר בֶּן אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן הֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת חֲמָתִ/י֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/קַנְא֥/וֹ אֶת קִנְאָתִ֖/י בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/ם וְ/לֹא כִלִּ֥יתִי אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/קִנְאָתִֽ/י
rows.fluent: “Phinehas son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, has turned my fury away from the Israelites. He acted among them with my own zeal, so I did not consume the Israelites in my zeal.

rows.hebrew: לָ/כֵ֖ן אֱמֹ֑ר הִנְנִ֨/י נֹתֵ֥ן ל֛/וֹ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֖/י שָׁלֽוֹם
rows.fluent: So announce: ‘I am giving him my covenant of peace.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הָ֤יְתָה לּ/וֹ֙ וּ/לְ/זַרְע֣/וֹ אַחֲרָ֔י/ו בְּרִ֖ית כְּהֻנַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִנֵּא֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהָ֔י/ו וַ/יְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
rows.fluent: It will be a covenant of lasting priesthood for him and his descendants after him, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the Israelites.’”

rows.hebrew: וְ/נִסְכּ/וֹ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ת הַ/הִ֔ין לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָ֑ד בַּ/קֹּ֗דֶשׁ הַסֵּ֛ךְ נֶ֥סֶךְ שֵׁכָ֖ר לַ/יהוָֽה
rows.fluent: Its drink offering is one-quarter of a hin for each lamb. Pour out a drink offering of fermented drink to the LORD in the holy place.

rows.hebrew: וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֗ם חֲצִ֣י הַ/הִין֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לַ/פָּ֜ר וּ/שְׁלִישִׁ֧ת הַ/הִ֣ין לָ/אַ֗יִל וּ/רְבִיעִ֥ת הַ/הִ֛ין לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ יָ֑יִן זֹ֣את עֹלַ֥ת חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ בְּ/חָדְשׁ֔/וֹ לְ/חָדְשֵׁ֖י הַ/שָּׁנָֽה
rows.fluent: The drink offerings of wine are half a hin for each bull, one-third of a hin for the ram and one-quarter of a hin for each lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering for every month of the year.

rows.hebrew: וּ/בֶ/עָשׂוֹר֩ לַ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֜י הַ/זֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/עִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵי/כֶ֑ם כָּל מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ
rows.fluent: On the tenth day of this seventh month, hold a holy assembly. Humble yourselves, and do no work at all.

rows.hebrew: שְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִ/לְּ/בַ֞ד חַטַּ֤את הַ/כִּפֻּרִים֙ וְ/עֹלַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֔יד וּ/מִנְחָתָ֖/הּ וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶֽם
rows.fluent: Also bring one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement and the regular burnt offering, with its grain offering and their drink offerings.

rows.hebrew: אִישׁ֩ כִּֽי יִדֹּ֨ר נֶ֜דֶר לַֽ/יהוָ֗ה אֽוֹ הִשָּׁ֤בַע שְׁבֻעָה֙ לֶ/אְסֹ֤ר אִסָּר֙ עַל נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ לֹ֥א יַחֵ֖ל דְּבָר֑/וֹ כְּ/כָל הַ/יֹּצֵ֥א מִ/פִּ֖י/ו יַעֲשֶֽׂה
rows.fluent: When a man makes a vow to the LORD or swears an oath that binds him to an obligation, he must not break his word. He must do everything he has spoken.

rows.hebrew: כָּל נֵ֛דֶר וְ/כָל שְׁבֻעַ֥ת אִסָּ֖ר לְ/עַנֹּ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ אִישָׁ֥/הּ יְקִימֶ֖/נּוּ וְ/אִישָׁ֥/הּ יְפֵרֶֽ/נּוּ
rows.fluent: Her husband may confirm or cancel any vow or sworn obligation by which she undertakes to humble herself.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם הָפֵ֥ר יָפֵ֛ר אֹתָ֖/ם אַחֲרֵ֣י שָׁמְע֑/וֹ וְ/נָשָׂ֖א אֶת עֲוֺנָֽ/הּ
rows.fluent: If he cancels them after he has heard, he must bear her guilt.”
